landing.hero_sub: Scan a barcode or QR code and get an instant ALLOW / DENY decision with the student's photo, programme and admission number — plus a permanent audit trail for every entry and exit.
landing.trust_2: Full offline mode with local cache
landing.feat_sub: Built specifically for ATC's security and administration requirements — fast, reliable, and simple to operate.
landing.feat_1_body: USB barcode scanner or device camera QR scan — both give a full student profile and access decision in under one second.
landing.feat_2_body: Each scan shows the student's photo from the database alongside their name, programme, year and admission number.
landing.feat_3_body: Suspend students with a reason and optional auto-restore date. Visitor passes expire automatically.
landing.feat_4_body: Hardware USB/Bluetooth barcode scanner mode with a large auto-focused input, plus device camera QR code mode with a scan-frame overlay.
landing.feat_5_body: Add, edit, bulk-import via CSV, generate ID cards as PDFs, suspend, graduate, or delete records — all in one place.
landing.feat_6_body: Hourly scan charts, weekly trends, programme-level attendance rates, absentee lists, and CSV/PDF export.
landing.feat_7_body: Resend-powered emails alert parents automatically whenever their child is denied access at the gate.
landing.feat_8_body: No internet? Scans are recorded locally in IndexedDB and sync to the local database the moment the connection is restored.
landing.feat_9_body: Manage multiple named gates across campus. Each access log records which gate and which operator performed the scan.
landing.step_1_body: The student holds their ID card up to the barcode scanner or, on mobile, to the device camera. The QR code on the back is read instantly.
landing.step_2_title: System checks status in real time
landing.step_2_body: The scanned code is matched against the local PostgreSQL database. Status, suspension, expiry and time-based access rules are evaluated in under a second.
landing.step_3_body: A full-screen ALLOW or DENY card shows the student's photo and details. The event is written to the permanent audit log and the parent is notified if access is denied.
landing.access_sub: Separate permission tiers keep security staff focused and administrators in control.
landing.admin_sub: Manage the entire system — students, users, gates, settings, and all reports.
landing.admin_feat_1: Dashboard with live analytics & denial alerts
landing.admin_feat_2: Add, edit, suspend and delete students
landing.admin_feat_3: Bulk CSV import and ID card PDF export
landing.admin_feat_4: Gate management and time-based access rules
landing.op_sub: Everything a security officer needs — nothing they don't.
landing.cta_sub: Sign in with your ATC staff credentials to start scanning.
landing.footer_tagline: Barcode-based student access control for Arusha Technical College. Built for reliability, speed, and simplicity.
